generic_lessons: Resolve native recommendation hashes before assigning an improvement type. Terrain and civic metadata do not prove an eligible builder action or yield effect.
A clock icon can display geometric distance; inspect the actual original consumer and verified component ports before treating it as a schedule.
Keep estimates local to ranking; native authorization still rereads capacity, endpoint, path and safety. Unknown scores should keep the entire default order; do not invent zero components.
Validate the source/installer/version consumers separately. Updating the text allowlist but not the numeric allowlist caused 18 static fixture errors; after correcting both, rerun the entire suite.
